core.headline: Four-bedroom detached house, Beech Avenue, Sevenoaks
core.summary: Extended family home with double garage on a 0.3-acre plot in Sevenoaks. Built in 1968, this detached house offers a spacious kitchen/family room, two receptions, four bedrooms, two bathrooms and driveway parking.
core.listing:
27 Beech Avenue is a four-bedroom detached house on a 0.3-acre plot with a double garage. Built in 1968, the property has been extended to create an open-plan kitchen and family room.

The ground floor comprises two reception rooms and the extended kitchen/family room. The principal reception faces the front, while the second reception opens to the rear garden. The kitchen and family area runs the width of the extension, with space for dining and seating.

On the first floor, the principal bedroom overlooks the rear garden. Three further bedrooms and two bathrooms complete the accommodation. The main bathroom serves the family bedrooms, and a second bathroom provides additional facilities.

The rear garden extends to 0.3 acres. A driveway provides off-street parking and leads to the double garage, offering covered storage and workshop space.

Sevenoaks town centre lies approximately two miles to the south, with its mainline railway station providing services to London. The property is within reach of local schools and the A21 for road connections to the M25.

Guide Price £850,000. Freehold. Council Tax band G (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. FTTC broadband and good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining issues: none known. Japanese knotweed found in the rear garden near the boundary in 2025; herbicide treatment plan by a PCA-registered contractor in progress, with a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee.
keyFeatures: Extended kitchen/family room across the full width of the extension
Driveway parking with access to double garage
Four bedrooms over the first floor
Two reception rooms on the ground floor
Approximately two miles from Sevenoaks town centre and railway station
